assessment.title: SAMPLE Week 1 test-out — not for real use
assessment.instructions_md: Fictional Week 1 practitioner test-out for platform testing. Includes safety and data-handling items at a sample standard only.

items.prompt_md: **Safety:** Before pasting client data into a public AI tool, what must you do first?

options.text: Check the data rules and remove or anonymise sensitive fields
Paste everything so the model has full context

items.explanation_md: Client identifiers and personal data must not enter unapproved tools.

items.prompt_md: **Safety:** A colleague shares a screenshot with visible email addresses in a shared channel. What is the best response?

options.text: Ask them to delete it and repost a redacted version
Forward it to your personal email for reference

items.prompt_md: **Safety:** Which item is acceptable to include in a prompt sent to an approved workspace AI?

options.text: Aggregated campaign metrics with no client names
A CSV export of customer phone numbers

items.explanation_md: Only non-sensitive or approved data may be used.

items.prompt_md: What is the main purpose of giving clear context in a prompt?

options.text: So the model can tailor the answer to the task and audience
So the answer is always shorter

items.prompt_md: When an AI draft includes a statistic you did not source, you should:

options.text: Verify or remove it before using the draft
Assume the model is correct because it sounds confident

items.explanation_md: Human review is required for factual claims.

items.prompt_md: Which habit best reduces hallucinated details in client-facing copy?

options.text: Ask for bullet points tied to supplied facts only

items.explanation_md: Constraining output to supplied facts helps accuracy.

items.prompt_md: After receiving a useful AI workflow from a teammate, you should:

options.text: Save or document it in the team prompt library with notes
Keep it only in your chat history

items.prompt_md: A test-out quiz with one attempt means you should:

options.text: Review the safety rules and prepare before starting
Submit quickly and rely on review later
